bot.name: LAGDA Chatbot
bot.subtitle: writing assistant
bot.privacyNote: LAGDA Chatbot uses built-in templates and rules. Nothing you type leaves your browser.
greeting: Hi {name}! I'm LAGDA Chatbot. Tell me what you'd like to write — for example “an NDA between Acme Inc. and Juan Dela Cruz” — or pick a starting point below.
bot.disclaimer: I draft wording from templates; I can't give legal advice. Have a lawyer review important documents before anyone signs.

askName: What is the {label}'s name? (Or say “skip” to leave it blank.)
notFound: I couldn't find “{name}” among the participants. They are: {list}.
replies.rolesNote: I'll set these up as the template's roles, in this order. Templates store roles, not people — the names go into the document text only.
replies.rolesNoteOffline: Open a workspace to save roles. I'll still name everyone in the document text.

replies: Hi {name}! What would you like to write today?
Hello {name}! Tell me what the document is for and I'll draft it with you.
Hey {name}! Which document can I help you write?
You're welcome! Anything else you'd like to add?
Happy to help. Want to add a clause or adjust the tone?
Anytime! Let me know if you want to change anything.
Goodbye! Your conversation stays here until you save, leave or I write the draft.
See you! Close this panel any time — I'll keep our chat until you save or leave.

I can draft any of LAGDA's ready-made documents for you — just name one (for example “an NDA between Acme and Juan Dela Cruz”). I'll ask two or three quick questions, then write it into the page. I can also add standard clauses, or make the wording more formal, plainer, shorter, or split into headings.
I'm LAGDA Chatbot, a writing assistant built into this page. I work from built-in templates and rules — I'm not a person and I'm not a general AI, so I stick to drafting documents.
Nothing you type leaves your browser — I run entirely on this page with built-in templates and rules. The chat is deleted when I write your draft, when you save, or when you leave this page.
Here are the kinds of documents I can write. Pick a category:

examples: i want to add a clause
replies: Which clause would you like? Here are some common ones — or type one, like “add a force majeure clause”.
No problem — let's start fresh. What would you like to write?
All right.
Great.
Okay.
No problem — I'll leave a placeholder you can fill in later.

editRules.label: More formal
editRules.reply: Got it — I'll use formal wording and spell out contractions.

editRules.label: Plain language
editRules.reply: Sure — I'll use plain, everyday wording where I have it.

editRules.label: Shorter
editRules.reply: Okay — I'll keep only the essential clauses so the draft stays short.

editRules.label: Use headings
editRules.reply: Will do — each clause will get its own heading instead of a numbered list.

gibberish: Hmm, I couldn't make sense of that. Could you rephrase? For example: “write a lease agreement”.
Sorry, that didn't look like words I know. Try telling me the kind of document you need.
I didn't catch that. Try something like “an NDA between two companies”.
noMatch: I'm not sure I understood. I can write documents like NDAs, employment contracts, leases and service agreements — which one do you need?
Sorry, I didn't quite get that. Try naming the document you want, or browse the categories.
I couldn't match that to a document yet. Could you describe it differently?
clarify: Did you mean one of these?
Just to be sure — which of these did you mean?
I found a few close matches. Which one?

replies: That's outside what I can help with — I only draft documents on this page. What would you like to write?
I'm just a document-writing assistant, so I can't help with that. Shall we draft something?
I'd love to, but I only know about documents and clauses. Which document do you need?
I'm sorry I'm not getting it right. Let's try again — tell me which document you need and I'll do my best.
Sorry for the frustration. I work best with short requests like “write an NDA”. Want to try one?

patterns: will this hold up in court
replies: I can't give legal advice — I only help with wording. For a question like that, please have a lawyer review your document and situation. I'm happy to keep drafting in the meantime.
That needs a lawyer, not a writing assistant. I can't tell you what the law requires or whether a document will hold up — please have a qualified lawyer review it. Want to continue with the draft?

empty: Type a message or pick one of the options below.

replies.confirmWarning: This conversation will be cleared once I start writing.
replies.placementQuestion: Your page already has content. Should I add the draft below it, or replace everything?
notYet: No problem. You can add a clause, change the tone, or correct any detail — just tell me.
Sure, take your time. Want to add a clause or change the wording style?
clauseOnly: I'll write a {clause} clause for you.
slotRetry: Sorry, I didn't catch that. {question} (Or say “skip”.)
moreHelp: Anything else? You can add a clause, change the tone, or say “write it”.

clauses.title: Confidentiality
clauses.text: Each party receiving confidential information shall keep it confidential, shall use it only for the purpose of this Agreement, and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the other party.
clauses.plain: Each side will keep the other side's private information secret, use it only for this agreement, and not share it without written permission.

clauses.title: Exclusions from Confidential Information
clauses.text: Confidential information does not include information that is or becomes public through no fault of the receiving party, was lawfully known to the receiving party before disclosure, or is required to be disclosed by law or court order.

clauses.title: Return of Materials
clauses.text: Upon request or upon the end of this Agreement, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy all materials containing confidential information and confirm in writing that it has done so.

clauses.title: Term
clauses.text: This Agreement takes effect on {effectiveDate} and continues for {term}, unless terminated earlier under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving {noticePeriod} written notice to the other party. Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure the breach within fifteen (15) days of being notified.
clauses.plain: Either side can end this agreement by giving {noticePeriod} written notice. If one side seriously breaks the agreement and does not fix it within 15 days of being told, the other side can end it right away.

clauses.title: Payment Terms
clauses.text: {partyB} shall pay the amount of {amount} within thirty (30) days of receiving a valid invoice. Payments shall be made in Philippine Pesos by bank transfer or any other method the parties agree in writing.
clauses.plain: {partyB} will pay {amount} within 30 days of getting a proper invoice, in Philippine Pesos, by bank transfer or another method both sides agree on in writing.

clauses.title: Late Payment
clauses.text: Any amount not paid when due shall bear interest at the rate of one percent (1%) per month from the due date until fully paid.

clauses.title: Governing Law
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of the Philippines.

clauses.title: Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: The parties shall first try in good faith to settle any dispute arising from this Agreement through negotiation. If the dispute is not settled within thirty (30) days, either party may refer it to mediation, and failing that, to the proper courts of {venue}, to the exclusion of all other courts.

clauses.title: Arbitration
clauses.text: Any dispute that is not settled by negotiation shall be finally resolved by arbitration in {venue} under Republic Act No. 9285 (the Alternative Dispute Resolution Act of 2004). The arbitral award shall be final and binding on the parties.

clauses.title: Force Majeure
clauses.text: Neither party shall be liable for any delay or failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including natural disasters, typhoons, earthquakes, epidemics, war, strikes or acts of government. The affected party shall promptly notify the other party and resume performance as soon as possible.

clauses.title: Data Privacy
clauses.text: Each party shall process personal data received under this Agreement in accordance with Republic Act No. 10173 (the Data Privacy Act of 2012), its implementing rules and regulations, and the issuances of the National Privacy Commission, and shall use reasonable organisational, physical and technical measures to protect that data.
clauses.plain: Each side will handle personal data under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173) and the National Privacy Commission's rules, and will take reasonable steps to keep it safe.

clauses.title: Non-Competition
clauses.text: During the term of this Agreement and for {restrictionPeriod} after it ends, {partyB} shall not engage in any business that directly competes with {partyA} within {territory}, to the extent permitted by law.

clauses.title: Non-Solicitation
clauses.text: For {restrictionPeriod} after this Agreement ends, neither party shall solicit or hire the employees or clients of the other party without its prior written consent.

clauses.title: Warranties
clauses.text: Each party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement, and that its obligations under it do not conflict with any other agreement it is bound by.

clauses.title: Limitation of Liability
clauses.text: Except for breach of confidentiality or wilful misconduct, neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages, and each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total amount paid under it in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

clauses.title: Indemnity
clauses.text: Each party shall indemnify and hold the other party harmless from any claims, losses and expenses, including reasonable attorney's fees, arising from its own breach of this Agreement or its negligence.

clauses.title: Intellectual Property
clauses.text: Each party keeps ownership of the intellectual property it owned before this Agreement. Intellectual property created specifically for {partyA} under this Agreement shall belong to {partyA} upon full payment, and {partyB} shall sign any document reasonably needed to confirm this.

clauses.title: Notices
clauses.text: All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered personally, by courier, or by email to the addresses the parties give each other. A notice is received on delivery, or on the next business day if sent by email.

clauses.title: Entire Agreement
clauses.text: This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject and replaces all earlier discussions, understandings and agreements, whether written or oral.

clauses.title: Amendments
clauses.text: This Agreement may be changed only by a written document signed by both parties.

clauses.title: Severability
clauses.text: If any provision of this Agreement is found invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.

clauses.title: Assignment
clauses.text: Neither party may assign or transfer its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.

clauses.title: Waiver
clauses.text: A failure or delay by either party to enforce any provision of this Agreement shall not be a waiver of that provision or of any other right.

clauses.title: Counterparts and Electronic Signatures
clauses.text: This Agreement may be signed in counterparts, and signatures may be given electronically, to the extent permitted by Republic Act No. 8792 (the Electronic Commerce Act of 2000).

clauses.title: Independent Contractor
clauses.text: {partyB} is an independent contractor. Nothing in this Agreement creates an employer–employee relationship, partnership or joint venture between the parties.

clauses.title: Compliance with Laws
clauses.text: Each party shall comply with all laws, regulations and government issuances that apply to its obligations under this Agreement.

clauses.title: Probationary Period
clauses.text: The Employee shall serve a probationary period of up to six (6) months, during which the Employee's performance will be evaluated against the reasonable standards made known at the start of employment.

clauses.title: Working Hours
clauses.text: The Employee's regular working hours shall be eight (8) hours a day, five (5) days a week, excluding meal breaks, subject to the Employer's policies and the Labor Code of the Philippines.

clauses.title: Compensation and Benefits
clauses.text: The Employee shall receive a monthly salary of {amount}, less applicable taxes and statutory contributions, together with the benefits required by law, including 13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG contributions.

clauses.title: Security Deposit
clauses.text: {partyB} shall pay a security deposit of {deposit}, which will be returned within thirty (30) days after the end of this Agreement, less any unpaid amounts and the cost of repairing damage beyond normal wear and tear.

clauses.title: Rent
clauses.text: {partyB} shall pay a monthly rent of {amount} on or before the fifth (5th) day of each month.

clauses.title: Maintenance and Repairs
clauses.text: {partyB} shall keep the property or equipment in good condition and shall promptly report any damage. {partyA} shall be responsible for major repairs not caused by {partyB}'s fault.

clauses.title: Use of Property
clauses.text: The property shall be used only for its agreed purpose and in compliance with building rules and applicable laws. No alterations may be made without prior written consent.

clauses.title: Scope of Services
clauses.text: {partyB} shall perform the services described in the attached statement of work, with due care and in a professional manner.

clauses.title: Service Levels
clauses.text: The provider shall meet the service levels agreed by the parties, including {uptime}, and shall report any failure to meet them together with the steps taken to fix it.

clauses.title: Delivery
clauses.text: Goods shall be delivered to the agreed location on or before {deliveryDate}. Risk of loss passes to the recipient upon delivery and acceptance.

clauses.title: Inspection and Acceptance
clauses.text: The recipient shall inspect the goods within five (5) business days of delivery and may reject goods that are damaged or do not match the order, by written notice.

clauses.title: Insurance
clauses.text: Each party shall keep appropriate insurance to cover its liabilities under this Agreement and shall provide proof of insurance on request.

clauses.title: License Grant
clauses.text: {partyA} grants {partyB} a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the licensed material during the term of this Agreement, only for the purposes stated in it.

clauses.title: Repayment
clauses.text: {partyB} shall repay the loan of {amount} in equal monthly instalments, with interest at {interest}, starting one month after the loan is released.

clauses.title: Collateral
clauses.text: To secure the loan, {partyB} mortgages in favour of {partyA} the property described in the attached schedule, free from any other lien or encumbrance.

clauses.title: Release of Claims
clauses.text: Upon receiving the settlement amount, each party releases the other from all claims arising from the matter described in this Agreement.

clauses.title: No Admission of Liability
clauses.text: This settlement is not an admission of liability or wrongdoing by any party.

clauses.title: Transfer of Shares
clauses.text: No shareholder may sell or transfer shares without first offering them to the other shareholders on the same terms.

clauses.title: Profits and Losses
clauses.text: Profits and losses shall be shared among the partners in proportion to their capital contributions, unless they agree otherwise in writing.

clauses.title: Use of Funds
clauses.text: The Company shall use the investment only for the business purposes disclosed to the Investor.

clauses.title: Transfer of Title
clauses.text: The Seller shall deliver the owner's copy of the title and all documents needed to transfer title to the Buyer upon full payment of the purchase price.

clauses.title: Taxes and Fees
clauses.text: Unless the parties agree otherwise, capital gains tax shall be paid by the Seller, and documentary stamp tax, transfer tax and registration fees by the Buyer.

clauses.title: Patient Rights
clauses.text: The patient may ask questions at any time and may withdraw this consent before the procedure begins.

clauses.title: Revocation
clauses.text: This consent or authorisation may be withdrawn at any time by written notice, without affecting anything done before the withdrawal.

clauses.title: Code of Conduct
clauses.text: The student shall follow the school's rules and code of conduct as published in the student handbook.

clauses.title: Scholarship Conditions
clauses.text: The scholar shall maintain the required grades and enrolment status. The scholarship may be suspended if these conditions are not met.

clauses.title: Return Service
clauses.text: After completing the studies, the scholar shall render service to the grantor for the period stated in the attached schedule, if one applies.

clauses.title: Training Plan
clauses.text: The host company shall give the intern a training plan and a supervisor, and the intern shall follow reasonable instructions and workplace rules.

clauses.title: Security Measures
clauses.text: The receiving party shall keep appropriate technical and organisational security measures, including access controls, encryption where appropriate, and regular security reviews.

clauses.title: Breach Notification
clauses.text: The processor shall notify the controller of any personal data breach without undue delay, and in any case within seventy-two (72) hours of discovering it, so that the controller can meet its own reporting duties.

clauses.title: Acceptable Use
clauses.text: The user shall use system access only for authorised work, shall not share credentials, and shall report any suspected security incident immediately.

clauses.title: Company Equipment
clauses.text: Equipment issued to the employee remains company property and shall be returned in good condition when employment ends.

clauses.title: Deliverables
clauses.text: The content creator shall produce the deliverables listed in the attached brief, subject to the brand's reasonable review before publication.

clauses.title: Disclosure of Sponsorship
clauses.text: Sponsored content shall be clearly identified as paid or sponsored, in line with applicable advertising standards.

clauses.title: Sponsor Benefits
clauses.text: The organizer shall give the sponsor the benefits listed in the attached schedule, such as logo placement and mentions.

clauses.title: Nature of this Memorandum
clauses.text: This memorandum records the parties' shared intentions. Except for the confidentiality and governing law sections, it does not create binding obligations until a definitive agreement is signed.

clauses.title: Publication of Results
clauses.text: Either party may publish research results after giving the other party thirty (30) days to review the draft for confidential information.

clauses.title: Assignment of Rights
clauses.text: The assignor assigns to the assignee all rights, title and interest in the invention, including any patent applications and patents based on it.

clauses.title: Further Assurances
clauses.text: Each party shall sign any further documents reasonably needed to carry out this Agreement, including filings with the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines.

clauses.title: Warranty Exclusions
clauses.text: The warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse, accidents, unauthorised repairs or normal wear and tear.

clauses.title: Repair Terms
clauses.text: The service provider will contact the customer before doing work that exceeds the estimate. Items not collected within sixty (60) days of notice may be disposed of.

clauses.title: Refund Terms
clauses.text: Approved refunds are paid using the original payment method within fourteen (14) business days of approval.

clauses.title: Appointment
clauses.text: The supplier appoints the distributor as its {exclusivity} distributor for the territory of {territory} during the term of this Agreement.

clauses.title: Mitigation Plan
clauses.text: The identified risks and the controls to reduce them are listed in the attached risk register, with an owner and target date for each.

clauses.title: Test Plan
clauses.text: Testing shall follow the attached test plan, including safety precautions, success criteria and the people responsible.

clauses.title: Justification
clauses.text: Reason for the request: {purpose}. Budget line: [Budget Line]. Expected benefit: [Expected Benefit].

clauses.title: Declaration
clauses.text: I declare that the information in this form is true and complete to the best of my knowledge, and I understand that false information may lead to rejection.

clauses.title: Acknowledgment
